question: What is the antonym of "Noisome"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fragrant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Noisome"** refers to something that is unpleasant or offensive, especially to the sense of smell. (अप्रिय, दुर्गंधयुक्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The noisome odor from the garbage dump made it impossible to stay nearby.
 
 
• **"Fragrant"** refers to something that has a pleasant and sweet smell. (सुगंधित)
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was fragrant with the scent of blooming roses.
